Senior Backend Engineer - Financial Infrastructure

About Stripe:
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.

Role Description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Financial Infrastructure team. You will build high-throughput, zero-downtime ledger services, API integrations, and event-driven microservices processing billions of dollars in daily transactions.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with distributed systems in Go, Ruby, or Java
- Strong experience with SQL (PostgreSQL), Redis, Kafka, and idempotent transaction processing
- Track record of designing low-latency, highly available API services
- Excellent system design and fault-tolerant architecture skills
- Experience with observability, tracing (Datadog/OpenTelemetry), and automated testing

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement core accounting and settlement services
- Participate in on-call rotations and ensure 99.999% reliability
- Mentor junior engineers and collaborate across teams

Frontend Systems Engineer - Next.js Core

About Vercel:
Vercel's frontend cloud gives developers the frameworks, workflows, and infrastructure to build a faster, more personalized Web.

Role Description:
We are looking for an engineer to join the Next.js Core team. You will work on compiler performance, Turbopack, React Server Components, and client-side routing optimization.

Requirements:
- Deep expertise in React, Next.js, Webpack/Turbopack, and TypeScript
- Experience with AST manipulation, Babel, SWC, or Rust compiler tooling
- Strong understanding of web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals, SSR, streaming HTML)
- Passion for developer experience and open-source software

Responsibilities:
- Improve Next.js dev server startup times and hot module reloading
- Maintain open-source repositories and engage with community feedback
